features: TRAPS AND NEUTRALIZES TOBACCO ODORS: Keep your home fresh and clean by replacing your Hamilton Beach TrueAir filters. These carbon filters were specially formulated to neutralize pet odors.
FITS TRUEAIR ODOR ELIMINATORS: Carbon Replacement Filter fits Hamilton Beach TrueAir models 04384, 04532GM, 04530G, 04530GM & 04531GM
LONG LASTING 3-PACK: This package contains 3 filters, made to last up to 90 days.
EASY TO INSTALL: Replacing your Hamilton Beach True Air filters is easy. Simply, place the filter in the unit, fitting the notched corner of the filter around notched edge of the odor eliminator.
description: Keep your home fresh and clean by replacing your Hamilton Beach TrueAir filters. These carbon filters were specially formulated to neutralize common household odors. This package contains 3 filters, made to last up to 90 days.* These filters will work with the following TrueAir Odor Eliminators: TrueAir Plug-Mount Odor Eliminator with night light 04531GM True Air Plug-Mount Odor Eliminators 04530GM TrueAir Room Odor Eliminator 04532GM and TrueAir compact Air Purifier with true HEPA filter 04383A, 04384 and 04386A.
